name: Ironclad: Rail Defence
subtitle: Armoured Train Tower Defence
promotionalText: Your tower is an armoured train. Couple on Gatlings, cannons and mortars, hold off the raiders mile after mile, and bring home steel for a stronger train.
description:
Your tower is an armoured train.

Roll it across the frontier a mile at a time while raiders ride in from both sides and along the track. Every wagon is a weapon, the guns fire by themselves, and every run ends the same way: overrun, somewhere further down the line than last time.

BUILD THE TRAIN
• Nine wagons to find and build: Gatling, Cannon, Sharpshooter, Furnace, Mortar, Dynamo and more
• Support wagons work on the wagons next to them, and raiders from behind reach the last wagon first, so the order you couple them in matters
• Up to eight wagons behind the engine

EVERY RUN IS DIFFERENT
• Spend scrip mid-run on the wagons you need right now
• A boss rides every tenth mile; beat it to reach a station
• At each station, take one of three cards for the rest of the run and recouple your wagons
• Sound the whistle to throw raiders back, or tap one to point every gun at it

KEEP WHAT YOU EARN
• Steel from every mile buys workshop upgrades that last for good
• Five lines to cross, from the Prairie Line to Black Canyon
• The depot's patrols bring steel home while you're away
• A daily gift, daily tasks, awards, Game Center leaderboards and achievements

FAIR BY DESIGN
• No forced ads, ever: an ad only plays if you tap a button to watch one for a reward
• No energy and no waiting to play
• Everything in the game can be earned by playing

Play for two minutes or two hours. Your progress is saved in your own iCloud.
